cohort: 33 healthy full term infants born either vaginally or after caesarean section under spinal anaesthesia
finding: Healthy full term infants often showed abnormal general movement quality and lower motor optimality scores during the first week after birth, irrespective of the mode of delivery.
mod_finding: General movement quality and motor optimality score did not differ between infants born by vaginal delivery or after CS under spinal anaesthesia
